title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 2: seeking wisdom like silver, Yahweh who gives wisdom, and deliverance from evil men and the strange woman.

questions.text: How should a person seek wisdom, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: The father says, "if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures."

answers.text: As silver, and as hidden treasures
As a thirsty man seeks water
As a shepherd seeks a lost sheep
As a watchman waits for morning

questions.text: What will the seeker understand and find, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Then he will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

answers.text: The hidden secrets of the kings of the earth
The sure path to riches and lasting honor
The fear of Yahweh and the knowledge of God
The riddles and dark sayings of the wise

questions.text: Where do knowledge and understanding come from, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: It says Yahweh gives wisdom, and out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

answers.text: From the books of the wise

questions.text: To whom is Yahweh a shield?
questions.explanation: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright and is a shield to those who walk in integrity.

questions.text: What will discretion do for you, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: It says, "Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you."

questions.text: What do the men who speak perverse things forsake?
questions.explanation: They forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness.

questions.text: How does the strange woman work, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Wisdom delivers from the strange woman, the foreigner who flatters with her words.

questions.text: What has the strange woman forgotten?
questions.explanation: She forsakes the friend of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

answers.text: The vows of her wedding day

questions.text: Where does the strange woman's house lead?
questions.explanation: Her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

answers.text: To the edge of the wilderness

questions.text: What will happen to the upright and the wicked at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: It says the upright will dwell in the land and the perfect will remain in it, but the wicked will be cut off from the land.

answers.text: The upright will sit in judgment over all the wicked
The upright will inherit riches; the wicked will inherit poverty
The upright will dwell in the land; the wicked will be cut off from it
Both the upright and the wicked will be tested by fire
